content.short: Circular Protocol provides a 4th-gen Layer 1 blockchain addressing limitations of prior L1s.
content.description: Circular Protocol is a 4th-gen Layer 1 blockchain designed to address the limitations of prior L1s and to support healthcare, DeFi and GameFi applications. Organizations can subscribe to a dedicated blockchain without sacrificing decentralization or security, with sustainability at the core of the design. Circular Protocol employs a consensus approach with non-competitive mining to support miners, rather than sacrificing them as some proof-of-stake blockchains do.
